SRC-049:R001.text: Manual project ZIP control decoupled from Auto Audit: compact titlebar control available in ordinary ChatGPT chats, project popover fed by GET /v1/projects (select, change, clear binding, refresh list), explicit state labels (CHECK/PACK/GET/ATTACH/ZIP check/ZIP bang), no Auto enabled or campaign or START required (SRC-049 TARGET A, C, P).
